name: spike-rxdb-browser-harness
description: ISOLATED night-crew spike harness (card C, sync-rxdb-browser-delivery-spike). Has NO dependencies of its own on purpose: @playwright/test resolves up the tree to the repo-root node_modules, and the repo-root package.json/package-lock.json must stay BYTE-UNTOUCHED — they are the Playwright environment for every card in every worktree. serve.mjs is deliberately zero-dependency for the same reason. Nothing here ships.
